prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high for most tests, though tests with 0.0% or negative predictions (such as choose_path redesign and round 3 tests) significantly underpredicted positive results.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) won in 2 of 3 tests (+4.3% and +6.2%), but results remain inconsistent due to one strongly negative test (-4.3%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) yielded opposing outcomes across 2 tests (-3.9% lost vs +5.4% won), so no consistent rule can be established yet.
No clear effect was seen for home page changes (home wait_info, home new_flow, and home hint) across their individual tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path redesign, finish layout, home hint, home new_flow, and home wait_info, as each relies on only a single test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +5.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, hint: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +2.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Trait Grid Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a grid layout showcasing pet personalities, traits, and animated mascot previews. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 68.4% with median time 89s; visual personality traits lower choice friction.)
1: [home, redesign] Centered Generation Status View: Redesign the waiting screen with a centered layout, live preparation animation, and clear status text. (why: Waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off during background generation.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Split Account Sync Sign-In Layout: Redesign sign-in into a two-column split layout explaining cloud save backup on one side and sign-in buttons on the other. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after re-signing in, while sign-in conversion is 79.7%.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Path Explorer Carousel Layout: Re-layout choose_path screen into a interactive swipe carousel highlighting standard vs custom pets. (why: Choose path drops 17.9% of users and has an extreme mean duration of 514s.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Care Tip Cards: Display periodic pet care hints and interaction tips on the waiting screen while generation completes. (why: Median waiting screen duration is 201s, causing user churn while pet assets load.)

scores.note: High drop-off step (68.4% conversion), but adoption redesigns show mixed historical results.
Addresses high wait time, but home step redesigns historically show weak/no impact.
Strong evidence from both funnel drop-off and 8 support emails regarding sync issues.
High mean duration on choose_path; single past choose_path test showed positive lift.
Low-cost content addition during home wait, previous wait_info test yielded modest +1.7% lift.
